title: An evening at the Brown Derby
text: The booth next to yours: a studio accountant, a nervous producer and a columnist pretending not to listen. Three conversations you could walk into — pick your table.

choices.label: Talk the producer into a screen test for your roster
choices.outcome: By dessert the producer is sketching a part on the napkin. A project lands on your desk.
choices.outcome_fail: You push a beat too hard. The producer remembers a prior engagement — and the room notices.

choices.label: Quiet the columnist's newest story

effects.text: A story dies over a shared dessert. Nobody will ever know it existed.

choices.outcome: You trade one harmless anecdote for one dangerous silence. Fair market rates.
choices.outcome_fail: The columnist smiles, takes notes — and now knows what you consider dangerous.

choices.label: Work the room for a new name

effects.origin: over a late table at the Brown Derby

choices.outcome: Handshakes, first names, a card slipped across the tablecloth.
choices.outcome_fail: A long evening of familiar faces and small talk that leads nowhere.

choices.label: Just have dinner
choices.outcome: For once the town can wait until tomorrow. The steak is excellent.
